title: Accumulate unequal micro-batches by valid tokens

blocks.text: Sum all valid token losses and divide once by the global valid-token count. The task is: Backpropagate a global VALID-TOKEN mean using precomputed micro-batch per-token loss tensors and Boolean masks. Return detached loss. Sum each selected loss then divide by total valid tokens; ignore all-masked micro-batches. Caller zeroes gradients and steps optimizer. This single-process core does not apply a hidden DDP scale factor.

The inputs are `loss_vectors`, `masks`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
